'''Talus''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. He fought to defend the Republic's [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystal]] reserves in the [[Republic crystal refinery]] on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] during the [[Battle of Ilum]], but was [[Death/Legends|slain]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Master Talus is a named enemy who must be defeated to secure a store of green Adegan crystals in "A New Order," an Imperial mission on Ilum in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
